carpet.rule.autoDrop.name: Fake Player Auto Drop Pure Shulker Boxes
carpet.rule.autoDrop.desc: Enables the '/player <name> autodrop' command and allows triggering it by left-clicking a fake player with a cactus. Scans the fake player's inventory and throws out any Shulker Boxes that contain only a single type of item.
carpet.rule.bonemealSporeBlossom.name: Bone Meal Spore Blossoms
carpet.rule.bonemealSporeBlossom.desc: When enabled, using Bone Meal on a Spore Blossom will generate new Spore Blossoms
carpet.rule.torchflowerDropSeeds.name: Torchflowers Drop Seeds
carpet.rule.torchflowerDropSeeds.desc: Breaking a Torchflower will additionally drop 1-4 Torchflower Seeds.
carpet.rule.axeOxidizeCopper.name: Axe Oxidizes Copper
carpet.rule.axeOxidizeCopper.desc: Shift + Right-clicking a copper block with an Axe will advance its oxidation state to the next stage, acting as the exact opposite of scraping.
carpet.rule.batchPlayerCommand.name: Batch Player Command
carpet.rule.batchPlayerCommand.desc: Enables the '/playerManager batch <prefix> <start> <end> <action>' command for batch spawning, killing, and controlling fake players with Carpet action pack commands.
carpet.rule.playerInventoryStack.name: Custom Player Inventory Stack Size
carpet.rule.playerInventoryStack.desc: Allows /playerInventoryStack to customize item stack sizes in player inventories only; dropped items and other containers keep vanilla behavior
